title: Amyloid and aging reshape glial waste management in APP/PS1 mice
task: Characterizing age- and amyloid-dependent changes in glial waste-handling structures
key_results: PAS granules increased with age and amyloid pathology; extraparenchymal IgM+ granules declined with age; IgM+ astrocytes increased robustly with aging and amyloid, co-expressing complement C3
comments: Study identifies architectural remodeling of brain waste management with aging/Alzheimer's pathology, though causal mechanisms linking complement engagement to functional outcomes remain unclear.

model_io.model: APPswe/PS1dE9 transgenic mice and C57BL/6 controls at 3, 6, 12, 22 months

hypotheses.hypothesis: Glial waste-handling pathways shift from extraparenchymal to intracellular with aging and amyloid
hypotheses.result: EP granules declined with age while intracellular PAS granules and IgM+ astrocytes increased, supporting architectural remodeling

title: Specific targeting of cancer cell mitochondria with a malaria drug improves pancreatic cancer outcome
task: Targeting pancreatic cancer mitochondria with artemisinin-dye conjugate
key_results: DZ-ART1 accumulated 5-10 fold more in cancer vs normal cells; suppressed tumor growth and prolonged survival in KPC, syngeneic, and PDX models without normal tissue toxicity
comments: Novel mitochondria-targeting strategy combines therapeutic and diagnostic imaging, though clinical translation from preclinical models remains to be validated.

model_io.model: PDAC cell lines and transgenic/syngeneic/PDX tumor models

hypotheses.result: Mitochondrial depletion decreased DZ-ART1 uptake and cytotoxicity, confirming mitochondrial dependence

title: Safe MES-driven execution control for advanced manufacturing systems using constrained matrix zonotopes
task: Filter unsafe MES commands using constrained matrix zonotopes to ensure system-level safety
key_results: Empirical physical-safety rate 0.985, semantic-violation rate 0.058, erroneous-release rate 0.012, recovery time 23.6±6.1 s on 6,427 field decisions across three production lines
comments: Hybrid semantic-physical filtering trades off marginally higher safety margins in one metric for robustness across multiple safety dimensions; field validation on real 42-day production data strengthens credibility.

model_io.model: Constrained Matrix Zonotope (CMZ) filter + semantic module
inputs: MES rules (Boolean combinations of bounded linear predicates)

hypotheses.hypothesis: Projection-based CMZ filtering reduces semantic violations relative to pure CMZ
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; hybrid approach achieved more balanced trade-off with lower manual intervention

title: Dynamic heterogeneous graph-structured knowledge tracing with multi-behavior integration and temporal forgetting
task: Estimate learner knowledge states from heterogeneous events (videos, exercises, comments) with temporal decay
key_results: DHGKT-Core achieves test AUC 0.8529 vs. 0.8318 for exercise-only and 0.7508 for multi-behavior fusion baseline; video behavior course-dependent (improves 3/4 courses)
comments: Transparent event-driven decay mechanism outperforms generic graph convolution; semantic and social graph extensions show marginal/unreliable gains, questioning their necessity.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Exponential temporal decay of knowledge improves prediction over static embeddings
hypotheses.result: Confirmed for 3/4 courses; decay alone explains most gains without graph semantics

hypotheses.hypothesis: Video exposure signal (duration-aware) universally improves performance
hypotheses.result: Partially rejected; video helped 3 courses but degraded performance on C_801420

hypotheses.hypothesis: Semantic concept-video weighting and social extensions improve AUC
hypotheses.result: Rejected; no reliable additional gains; topology-aggregation variants produced negligible changes

title: A simulation study on the effect of bifurcation angles on the temperature characteristics in bifurcated tunnel fires
task: Predict maximum gas temperature rise in bifurcated tunnel fires as function of bifurcation angle
key_results: Empirical model ΔTmax/T0 = (5.855 + 1.921sinθ)Q*^(2/3) shows temperature increases with bifurcation angle; longitudinal decay follows double-exponential model in main tunnel
comments: Fire Dynamics Simulator validation on realistic geometry; practical applicability to urban tunnel safety design, though limited to 30–90° range and 5–30 MW fires.

outputs: maximum ceiling gas temperature rise ΔTmax

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dimensionless relationship ΔTmax/T0 ∝ kQ*^(2/3) remains valid but k depends on geometry
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; proportionality constant varies with sinθ per empirical model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Temperature decay in branch tunnel modulated differently than main tunnel
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; branch tunnel decay characteristics strongly dependent on bifurcation angle

title: A reproducible evaluation framework for benchmarking machine learning and hybrid ensemble models in power system anomaly detection
task: Benchmark ML and hybrid ensemble models for power system anomaly detection with interpretability
key_results: Stacking Hybrid achieves accuracy 0.9994, Voting Hybrid 0.9989, Gradient Boosting 0.9962; all models detect abrupt and gradual anomalies
comments: Impressive metrics but likely on a single curated dataset; hybrid ensembles dominate, though framework emphasizes relative comparison over absolute superiority; SHAP/LIME integration aids interpretability.

model_io.model: Random Forest, Logistic Regression, SVM-RBF, KNN, Gradient Boosting, Voting Hybrid, Stacking Hybrid

hypotheses.hypothesis: Hybrid ensemble approaches outperform single base models
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; Stacking Hybrid and Voting Hybrid achieve highest accuracy (0.9994, 0.9989)

hypotheses.hypothesis: All models can detect both abrupt cyber-physical anomalies and gradual drift
hypotheses.result: Confirmed across voltage sags, harmonic spikes, and operational drift patterns

title: Microwave metamaterial sensor for label-free dielectric characterization of biological equivalent media
task: Design microwave metamaterial biosensor for refractive index sensing of biological media
key_results: Sensitivity of 600 MHz/RIU, quality factor 22.46, figure of merit 5.34 at 2.1 GHz resonance frequency
comments: The sensor demonstrates competitive performance for label-free detection, though practical integration with fluidic handling systems and extended biological sample testing are needed.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Rectangular resonators enhance electromagnetic confinement and field–matter interaction
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; optimized structure achieves strong field localization and stable resonance under different material loading conditions

hypotheses.hypothesis: Resonance frequency shift correlates with refractive index change of analytes
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; systematic parametric analysis demonstrates sensing mechanism validity for biological-equivalent media
